description: This file contains the implementation of a generic directed graph utility class 'Digraph' with methods for constructing the graph, validating its structure, and performing topological sorting assuming acyclicity.

classes.name: Digraph
classes.description: A generic utility class for representing and working with directed graphs, supporting construction from a specification map, cycle detection, and topological sorting.

methods.name: Digraph
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the directed graph from a map of source nodes to their target nodes, validating the graph structure.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of the nodes, assuming the graph is acyclic, and returns a list of nodes in sorted order.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: A recursive helper method implementing depth-first search to facilitate topological sorting and cycle detection.
